items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Cat in a band, me and Cat was gambling

ctx.x: I worked with Cat in a band, me and Cat was gambling, Cat lost all his money so he said, ―Hey Snooky, let me have some money.‖ I said, ―Ok.‖ I think I gave him ten or fifteen dollars, something like that. I asked him for my money and he say, ―You better get out of here, get away from me.‖ I asked him for it a couple days later, I say, ―Give me my money, I get [inaudible] money, you better get out of here, I ain‘t thinking about you.‖ That‘s what he did, that‘s the kind of cat he was, Cat was strange, man. But he…
